design_philosophy: The P14s is the budget CAD starter line: a 14.5" ThinkPad with ISV certification and business manageability for engineers and drafting students who move daily. This top config loads the chassis to its ceiling — 64GB and 2TB — with the entry RTX PRO 500 GPU, prioritizing capacity and portability over GPU throughput.
